bundle.shortDescription: Governed AI control plane — your apps as one system
bundle.longDescription: ReDevOps runs your business apps as one governed agentic system: connect apps, run missions across them, approve the consequential steps. One suite installer, native, bring your own model (hosted or local). No Docker required.
